title: Intelligence
subtitle: Measured performance, grounded recommendations, and a clear workflow, nothing posts automatically.

overview.title: What this tab shows
overview.body: KPIs and platform breakdown from synced posts. Blank cells mean the platform did not report that metric, never zero. Use this to see where measured performance is strongest.

audience.title: Set your brand boundary
audience.body: Objective, markets, timezone, and pillars tell Intelligence who you create for. Audience Fit in Content and alignment scores compare drafts and results against this profile.

content.title: Learn from posts that already worked
content.body: Top content ranked by measured views. Reuse themes and formats here when writing in Content. Timing windows appear once you have enough dated posts with metrics.

opportunities.title: What to try next
opportunities.body: Recommendations come from your measured history, timing, platform mix, learnings, and alignment gaps. They are suggestions only: you execute them manually in Content or Calendar.

playbook.title: Patterns that repeat in your data
playbook.body: Statistical learnings from posts with enough sample size (platform, timing, format, etc.). Accept when the pattern fits your strategy; dismiss when it does not.

advanced.title: Test ideas with evidence
advanced.body: Create an A/B experiment, assign measured posts to each arm, then Evaluate. Ask Markaestro answers from your workspace data only, not generic social-media advice.

opportunities.title: How to use opportunities
opportunities.step1: Read the recommendation and what evidence it used (timing, platforms, or alignment).
opportunities.step2: Accept if you plan to try it, Pin to revisit later, or Dismiss if it is not relevant.
opportunities.step3: Go to Content or Calendar to publish or schedule. Accept does not create posts or campaigns automatically.

playbook.title: How to use the playbook
playbook.step1: Each card is a measured pattern (sample size shown as n=). Stronger evidence means more posts behind the claim.
playbook.step2: Accept patterns you want to repeat, Pin ones to revisit, or Dismiss patterns that do not fit this brand.
playbook.step3: Apply accepted patterns yourself when composing, for example post more on a winning platform or in a strong time window.

decisions.hint: These buttons record your decision only. They do not publish, schedule, or change drafts.
decisions.learningHint: Record whether you trust this pattern. Intelligence will not change your content automatically.
decisions.accept: Accept: I plan to act on this

platforms.title: Platform performance
platforms.empty: Published posts will appear here as metrics arrive.

empty.overviewBody: This brand has no synced posts yet. Markaestro-published posts and imported platform history appear here after they are projected into Intelligence. Missing metrics stay blank, never zero.
empty.noBrandBody: Intelligence is scoped to a Markaestro brand.
empty.profileBody: Add an objective, target market, timezone, and platform priorities in brand settings.
empty.contentBody: Published and imported platform posts appear here without turning missing metrics into zero.
empty.opportunitiesBody: Recommendations appear when Intelligence has enough measured evidence, for example two platforms to compare, a strong posting window, or a repeatable learning. Keep publishing and syncing metrics.
empty.playbookBody: Statistical patterns appear after enough measured posts in a group (typically five or more). Check back as more posts sync, or review Opportunities for action-oriented suggestions.

composer.title: Audience Fit
composer.body: Scores this draft against your saved audience profile. Suggestions never change your draft until you tap Apply.
composer.failed: The analysis could not be completed safely.
composer.coldStart: Cold start: fewer than five relevant posts.

profile.objectiveHint: This selects which measured metric intelligence optimizes toward.
profile.platformHint: Used to rank platform-specific recommendations. Other connected channels stay available.
profile.listHint: Pick from the dropdown, each selection adds a tag you can remove.
profile.voiceHint: Choose tone traits that describe how this brand should sound.
profile.saveFailed: Could not save the audience profile
profile.unavailable: Audience profile is not enabled for this workspace.

actions.acceptedToast: Marked as accepted, execute in Content or Calendar
actions.dismissedToast: Dismissed and hidden from this list

alignment.title: Audience alignment
alignment.empty: Alignment appears after a measurable audience mix is captured. Missing dimensions stay blank.

timing.title: Best posting windows
timing.empty: Account-specific timing needs 20 dated posts and five observations in the cited hour.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.empty: Name a campaign to group posts you want to compare across platforms. Creating one here does not publish anything, assign posts as you publish from Content.
campaigns.name: Campaign name

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.emptyPaired: No experiments yet. Create a per-platform A/B test with two scheduled posts below.
experiments.pairedWorkflow: Pick one platform, write two variants (different caption, media, and/or time), schedule both, and run them for a set window. When the window ends, results land in your Inbox. Side-by-side shows the live post when a permalink exists.
experiments.name: Experiment name
experiments.hypothesis: Hypothesis (e.g. shorter hooks get more views)
experiments.createdPaired: Experiment created, both posts are scheduled
experiments.captionPlaceholder: Caption and hashtags for this arm
experiments.mediaRequired: This platform needs media on both arms before you can create the experiment.
experiments.mediaRequiredHint: Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest need at least one image or video on each arm.
experiments.livePending: Live embed appears after this post publishes and Markaestro stores its permalink.
experiments.deleteWarning: This removes the experiment, its scheduled A/B posts, and related inbox results from Markaestro. Posts already live on the platform are not removed.

result.winner_a: Arm A is ahead on the measured metric.
result.winner_b: Arm B is ahead on the measured metric.
result.inconclusive: Result is inconclusive, need a larger sample or a clearer difference.

ask.title: Ask Markaestro
ask.placeholder: Ask about measured performance, timing, or learnings.
ask.failed: Could not answer that question. Try again.
ask.timeout: That took too long, try a shorter question, or ask again in a moment.
ask.quota: You have used this month’s Ask Markaestro turns. Try again next month or upgrade.
ask.unavailable: Ask Markaestro is not available for this workspace yet.

links.title: Tracked links
links.empty: Create a tracked link to attribute clicks without storing raw IP addresses.
links.label: Label

errors.unavailableBody: This phase is not enabled for this workspace or could not be loaded.
